name: pickaxetax
description: Blocks re-reads of files that have not changed since the agent last read them (once per file; a repeated request is allowed), resets on compaction, and records the tokens avoided. Requires `pip install pickaxetax` (or pipx). #AntiTokenMaxing

hooks.command: command -v pxt >/dev/null 2>&1 && pxt agent hook pre-tool-use || true
command -v pxt >/dev/null 2>&1 && pxt agent hook pre-compact || true
